title: Insulin Pump Program Payment Plan Term Schedule
content:
The plan months of a payment plan on an Insulin Pump Program follow the program balance — the remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds posted on the program less its payments and balance adjustments:

| Program balance | Effect on the tier's payment-plan maximum months |
|---|---|
| below $150.00 (the short-term ceiling) | replaced with 2 months (the short-term months) |
| at least $150.00 and below $300.00 (the mid-term ceiling) | replaced with 4 months (the mid-term months) |
| $300.00 or more | the maximum months stand |

## Edges of the bands (hypothetical balances)

| Program balance | Effect |
|---|---|
| $149.99 | replaced with 2 months |
| $150.00 | replaced with 4 months |
| $299.99 | replaced with 4 months |
| $300.00 | the maximum months stand |
